content.introduction: According to Investtech, the S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term, indicating good market development. However, the price has broken a support level in the short term, signaling a negative short-term trading range. The index is approaching resistance at 7800 points, which may cause a negative reaction, but a break upwards through 7800 points will be positive. The RSI curve shows a falling trend, indicating a possible trend reversal downwards for the price. The index is technically neutral for the medium long term. The S&P 500 closed at 7623.68 on Oct 23, 2026, down by 39.75.
